title: Filings: Baidu's AI chip unit Kunlunxin is planning a dual IPO on Shanghai's STAR Board and in Hong Kong; Baidu holds a 58% stake in Kunlunxin (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Filings: Baidu's AI chip unit Kunlunxin is planning a dual IPO on Shanghai's STAR Board and in Hong Kong; Baidu holds a 58% stake in Kunlunxin — Baidu Inc.'s chip unit Kunlunxin is planning an initial public offering on Shanghai's Nasdaq-style bourse in addition to a separate listing plan …
